laws.rule: Hāʻena State Park: non-residents must reserve before arrival (up to 30 days ahead): entry US$5 (about A$7.10 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026) per person (3 and under free) and parking US$10 per vehicle per time slot; both are needed. Residents with Hawaiʻi ID free.
laws.heading: Hāʻena State Park

sources.title: Hāʻena State Park

local-law.note: Conflict: a search snapshot of the Go Hāʻena booking site shows US$20 per car per time slot; the DLNR page read directly says US$10, recorded here.
